overall_quality.evidence: Containerization is a method of packaging software applications along with their dependencies into a standardized unit for software development, known as a container. Containers are lightweight, portable, and self-sufficient, which means they can run consistently across different environments, from development to production. This approach helps to solve the "works on my machine" problem, where software that runs fine on one system might not work on another due to differences in the environment.
